svg.text: Each socket slot takes its own color from the Okabe-Ito set, which stays apart under every common color blindness; the
four node-kind slots reuse the nearest.
Each ring is a Default color, each dot the palette's; the arrows are the moves between, in order:
HUE AND COLORFULNESS: angle is hue, distance out is chroma
Authored: fully achromatic and a step crisper, so the Okabe-Ito hues carry the type signal.
